title: SolutionShortlist
description: Michael Agent's response envelope when routing an intent to solutions. Instead of silently auto-selecting the top-1 (the shape Zurich's Damian falls back to), Michael returns a ranked SHORTLIST with every candidate's matchReason, counterTestStatus, and accessDecision. Auto-route only fires when the top-2 score gap exceeds threshold AND top counterTestStatus == 'confirmed' AND top accessDecision == 'granted'; otherwise the user picks. Empties are signal: `shortlist: []` with an emptyReason is a valid response, not a bug.

intent.description: The intent set this shortlist was derived from. Michael's extract_multi_intent can produce primary + secondary + tertiary; each contributes to matchReason on each candidate.

abbRequirement.description: The ABB slot the shortlist is filling. Absent for intent-only routing that doesn't resolve to an ABB (some conversational replies stay in Michael and never route).

shortlist.description: Candidates ranked descending by score. minItems is 0 — an empty shortlist with `emptyReason` is a first-class output (no participant claimed this ABB, or every candidate failed access/counter-test).

emptyReason.description: Required when shortlist is empty. A specific reason ('no participant in MAR claims ABB.03', 'all 4 candidates deny access for this user'), not a generic one. Present iff shortlist is empty.

autoRouteVerdict.description: Whether Michael would auto-route (bypassing user pick) on this shortlist. Auto-route is only offered when the top-2 gap exceeds threshold, counter-test is confirmed, and access is granted; otherwise the user must pick.

derivedFrom.description: Provenance. If either digest changes after this response, the shortlist is stale and any re-derivation may differ.

participantRef.description: GitHub-style owner/repo — matches MeshActionRegistry.participants[*].repo. This is the LINK back to the registry entry, not a copy of its manifest (which would drift).

score.description: Composite rank in [0,1]. Cue-coverage (from intent extraction) x trust_score (from a2a-trust) x freshness. A candidate below abb-catalog min_trust_score is filtered out BEFORE ranking, so appearing here means the trust floor passed.

matchReason.description: WHY this candidate matched. e.g. 'intent:cross-selling cue matched participant catalog verb', 'ABB.03 claim verified against protocol.reads'. A candidate with a reason nobody can read is a candidate nobody should route to; minItems: 1 stops empty-reason candidates from appearing.

counterTestStatus.description: Per Noetica#570's counter-test gate. `confirmed` = counter-test ran and did not refute. `available` = counter-test exists but has not been run. `unavailable` = no counter-test defined. Auto-route requires `confirmed`; the other states appear in the shortlist but Michael declines to auto-select them.

counterTestRef.description: Present when status is `confirmed` — the receipt of the counter-test that ran.

url.description: Signed prefilled consent-request URL. The signature binds it to user + purpose + expiry, so an intercepted URL cannot be replayed for a different scope.

expectedReturn.description: On approval the caller receives an ArtifactConsentRecord that chains into the dispatch-ledger — closing the loop rather than trusting the URL was followed.
